comparison.objective: Select and hand off the requested M4×20 screw; candidate adjusts a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual size selection, small-part grasping, and tray placement versus hex-key insertion, collar tuning, and bounded locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one correct screw must lie near the tray floor; candidate requires safe repeated carriage stops and no drift.
comparison.reason: Small-part handling is a generic shared challenge, not the same tested mechanical ability.
